indications: Proparacaine hydrochloride ophthalmic solution is indicated for procedures in which a topical ophthalmic anesthetic is indicated; corneal anesthesia of short duration, e.g. tonometry, gonioscopy, removal of corneal foreign bodies and for short corneal and conjunctival procedures.
contraindications:
Usual Dosage: Removal of foreign bodies and sutures, and for tonometry: 1 to 2 drops (in single instillations) in each eye before operating.
                  Short corneal and conjunctival procedures: 1 drop in each eye every 5 to 10 minutes for 5 to 7 doses.
                  
                     NOTE:Proparacaine hydrochloride ophthalmic solution USP, 0.5% should be clear, colorless to faint yellow color. If the solution becomes darker, discard the solution.

 
                  
                     FOR TOPICAL OPHTHALMIC USE ONLY
warningsAndPrecautions:
Proparacaine hydrochloride ophthalmic solution USP, 0.5% is supplied in a plastic bottle with a controlled drop tip and a white polypropylene cap in the following size:
                  NDC 85766-057-15 15 mL bottle (relabeled from NDC 24208-730-06)
adverseReactions: Proparacaine hydrochloride ophthalmic solution is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients of this preparation.
name: Proparacaine Hydrochloride
